SASBDB entry SASDWT5  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDWT5/)

Publication: Rinaldi et al. (2026), Commun Biol
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1038/s42003-026-11218-4

The files are the SASBDB downloads, unchanged (nothing was cleaned):
  experimental_data/SASDWT5.dat   the curve (columns q, I, error)
  SASDWT5_fit1.fit              the FoXS fit of "fit1"
  SASDWT5_fit1_model1.pdb: AlphaFold model of the BRC4/delta97-RAD51 complex
Only fit1 is used. Script: test/fitting_tests/SASDWT5/ (buffer, temperature and wavelength: see its header comments).
Added 2026-11-15; not yet run.
